name: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics — Population and Housing Census 2022: District Reports, Community Reports (Table C-01) and Union Statistics, Barishal Division
organization: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS), Statistics and Informatics Division, Ministry of Planning
attribution: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics, Population and Housing Census 2022
notes: Population/households are final ENUMERATED counts (census moment 00:00 15 June 2022, incl. floating population), not PEC-adjusted. Unit lists and population per district/upazila/city corporation/thana/paurashava/union/ward from the Community Report Excel files, sheet C-01 (Barguna's workbook names it 'C01') (BBS 2022 geocodes; code_scheme BBS_GEOCODE_2022 = C-01 code columns joined with '-', prefixed by division 10). City-corporation units carry the city-corporation code in the geocode, so the 30 wards and 230 mahallas of Barishal City Corporation (10-06-50, one metro thana: Barishal Sadar Thana 10-06-50-51) are kept apart from paurashava wards and from Barishal Sadar upazila (10-06-51). Administrative-unit counts, area and density from the District Report Key Findings tables (District Series, May-June 2024) and Union Statistics (June 2025) Table D01. basis: enumerated | as stated (printed in a BBS table) | derived (counted from the C-01 geocode rows). Every unit in the Union/Ward column outside the city corporation and paurashavas is a union ('... Union'); no cantonment, forest or other non-union unit is printed there in Barishal Division. The Community Report labels on the BBS page differ from the District Series labels for two districts (PATUAKHAL, JHALAKHATI). Large PDFs/Excel are not committed; fetch.py --division barishal re-downloads them (bbs.gov.bd needs the Sectigo DV R36 intermediate, added at runtime from its AIA URL).
